interpretation_notes: SSIM/PSNR measure exact pixel-level reconstruction of each specific real photo -- a stricter, different question from whether the output is a plausible scene given the geometry. The model hallucinates unseen content (specific rocks, sand ripples) it was never shown, so modest SSIM/PSNR here does not by itself mean poor quality.
KID (unbiased polynomial-kernel MMD^2) is well-defined at small n, unlike FID's Gaussian-covariance estimate -- preferred over FID for this test set size.

Generated images were normalized ('mean_std') using GLOBAL whole-set statistics before any metric was computed, never per-pair, so paired metrics (SSIM/PSNR) cannot be inflated by peeking at each image's own real target.
